Article 8 (Application Mutatis Mutandis)
Except as otherwise provided by these Rules, the provisions of the Civil Execution Act and the Civil Execution Rules shall apply mutatis mutandis to procedures for granting writs of execution, advance payment of expenses, etc. <Amended on June 28, 2002.>
